claude_proposed_widenings.name: reposition_attachment
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The caster can spend a Magic action on any turn while the spell persists to move the illusion to any other spot within range. The on_caster_spends_action trigger (standard_action: magic) exists and fits, but the resulting operation — repositioning the effect's spatial anchor to a new point within range — has no corresponding atom. force_move and teleport apply only to creatures; alter_item_kind applies to item forms. No atom moves a non-creature effect attachment to a new location. This is the same gap identified in Dancing Lights (reposition_attachment).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you are within range of the illusion, you can take a Magic action to cause the image to move to any other spot within range. As the image changes location, you can alter its appearance so that its movements appear natural for the image.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Duration.concentration.upcastRemovesConcentration
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: When cast with a level 4+ spell slot, Major Image loses its Concentration requirement and persists until dispelled. The DurationUpcastTier type supports only amount changes within the same duration unit; it cannot express a change in duration kind (concentration → permanent/until-dispelled). A new field on the concentration duration variant (e.g., upcastRemovesConcentration: { atSlot: number }) would cover this without requiring a full per-tier duration-kind union.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The spell lasts until dispelled, without requiring Concentration, if cast with a level 4+ spell slot.
